hook_0_3s: A voice says he loves crowds, then someone finds him.
story_beats: People ask where's Wally and never who Wally is.
He says it sometimes takes someone who really knows you to make you feel seen.
The close is gifts that say I get you. Etsy has it.
The description credits Where's Waldo / Where's Wally to DreamWorks Distribution, 2024.
